item.title: Tokushima Leisure Guide: Rafting, Rope Cars & Awa Puppet Theater
item.description: Tokushima Prefecture occupies the eastern portion of Shikoku, Japan’s smallest main island, and it rewards visitors who slow down and engage with its landscape on its own terms. The Yoshino River — one of Japan’s three great rapids rivers — cuts through mountains that drop sharply from ridgelines nearly 2,000 metres above sea level. Narrow vine bridges span chasms in valleys where sunlight reaches the forest floor for only a few hours each day.
